en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-205 According to the same documentation, Abdul Adheem ibn Abdullah Al-Hassani narrated that he asked Muhammad ibn Ali Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.)
about the Honorable the Exalted God’s words, ‘Woe be to thee, (O men!), yea, woe! Again, woe be to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!’ He (a.s.) replied, “The Honorable the Exalted God says,
‘You became distant from the good of this world. You will also become distant from the good of the Hereafter.’”
